label: Every word on the Account & key screen

params.name: lede
params.default: One thing in this portal talks to a paid service: Draft with AI, which sends your recording to Google Gemini. It runs on your own key, billed to your own Google account — never the portal's, never a colleague's.

params.name: ready_line
params.default: Draft with AI is on for your account, using {model}. Saved key ends {ends}.

params.name: no_key_line
params.default: Everything else still works — write the script yourself, or run the LLM Bridge in a model you already pay for.

params.name: budget_note
params.default: Google bills monthly and will not tell the portal your balance, so tell it what you are willing to spend. It subtracts what each run actually cost and warns you when the remainder gets thin. Set a real cap at Google →

params.name: budget_low
params.default: Your budget is nearly used up. Top it up at Google, then raise the number here.

params.name: currency_note
params.default: Every provider bills in US dollars. Amounts here are shown in your currency at a fixed rate the owner keeps - a guide to what a run costs, not an invoice.

params.name: rates_at
params.default: Live rates as of {at} (refreshed once a day).

params.name: rates_fixed
params.default: Fixed rates - the live feed has not answered yet.

params.name: rates_failed
params.default: The last ask of the rate feed failed ({why}); the previous rates stay until it answers.

params.name: privacy_note
params.default: Your key, your recordings, your manuals and your projects are visible to your account alone. Nobody else signed in here can list them, open them or spend against your key.

params.name: providers_note
params.default: Gemini is the default for everything. Add another provider's key below and pick it for text (scripts, shot lists, imports, checks) or stills; the Film step picks its video model per run. Prices are the providers' published ones; every run is booked to that provider's own budget.

params.name: pool_note
params.default: Keep several: a call goes to the default first, a key that hits its limit steps aside for an hour and the next one takes over, an invalid one waits until it passes a test. Every key stays on this server, shown by its last four characters only.

params.name: pool_add_first
params.label: The button when this provider has no key yet (the first one is not 'another')

params.name: budget_shared
params.label: Said beside the budget box: the money belongs to the provider, not to one key

params.name: pool_remove_body
params.default: The next key becomes the default. Nothing else changes.

params.name: runs_note
params.default: Your own runs only. Every AI and metered call, whether it cost anything or not — a free voice run is listed too, so the record is whole.

params.name: no_runs_body
params.default: Every AI draft and every generated video leaves a receipt here — what it cost, how long it took.

params.name: test_ok
params.default: Your key works with {model} — answered in {secs}s, cost {cost}.

params.name: test_switched
params.default: Google does not offer {from} to this key, so your model is now {model}.

params.name: dialog_note
params.default: The key stays on this server, for your account only. It is never shown to anyone — not even back to you: the box below only ever shows its last four characters. How to get one, step by step →

params.name: key_hint
params.default: Starts with AQ.… (new keys) or AIza… (older ones). Paste it from aistudio.google.com/apikey.

params.name: label_label
params.default: Label — whose account is this key from?

params.name: label_hint
params.default: e.g. explore.whattag Gmail or Work project. When this key runs out, messages name it, so you know which account to top up.

params.name: pool_rename_hint
params.default: Rename: say which account this key came from, so you know which one to top up.

params.name: model_hint
params.default: Flash is the cheap one that watches video. Pro costs more and reads a busy screen better.

params.name: saving_tries
params.default: Saving also tries it once — a fraction of a cent.

params.name: saved_asking
params.default: Saved. Asking Google whether it works…

params.name: works_switched
params.default: Key works. Google does not offer {from} to new keys, so your model is now {model}. Draft with AI is on.

params.name: works
params.default: Key works with {model}. Draft with AI is on.

params.name: saved_but_refused
params.default: The key is saved — fix it here and test again.

params.name: share_note
params.default: Someone with an account on this portal can run their own work on your key. It spends your balance, every run lands on your usage list, and you can take it back at any moment.
params.label: share_note

params.name: take_back_body
params.default: They stop being able to spend on this key straight away. What they already ran stays on your usage list and can still be billed.
params.label: take_back_body

params.name: give_back_body
params.default: You will not be able to run anything on it again unless its owner lends it to you once more.
params.label: give_back_body

params.name: borrowed_rename_hint
params.default: Your own name for this key - its owner keeps theirs
params.label: borrowed_rename_hint

params.name: usage_note
params.default: Every paid run this portal made on a key you own or a key you were lent - yours and other people's. A run somebody else made on your key shows only the beginning of what they called it; they see it whole and can check the bill against it.
params.label: usage_note

params.name: no_usage_body
params.default: Anything that costs money - a draft, a voice, a picture, a film - lands here with the key that paid for it.
params.label: no_usage_body

params.name: bills_note
params.default: What people owe you for using your keys, and what you owe for using theirs. Money moves outside this portal; this is the record of it.
params.label: bills_note

params.name: bill_push_body
params.default: {runs} runs on {label}. They see it on their own Account & key screen, with every run behind it.
params.label: bill_push_body

params.name: bill_settle_body
params.default: This records that you settled it. It does not move any money.
params.label: bill_settle_body

params.name: no_bills_body
params.default: Lend a key and a bill line appears here the moment somebody spends on it.
params.label: no_bills_body

params.name: shared_note
params.default: Keys you lent to other people, and keys other people lent to you. A lent key spends the OWNER's balance, on the owner's terms.
params.label: shared_note

params.name: shared_none_lent
params.default: You have not lent a key to anyone.
params.label: shared_none_lent

params.name: shared_none_held
params.default: Nobody has lent you a key.
params.label: shared_none_held

params.name: terms_markup
params.default: Add on top of what each run costs (%)
params.label: terms_markup

params.name: terms_markup_hint
params.default: 0 means they pay exactly what the provider charges you. They only ever see the price with this added.
params.label: terms_markup_hint

params.name: terms_cap_hint
params.default: 0 means no cap. Measured on a rolling window, on the price they see. The key stops working when a cap is spent and starts again as the window rolls on.
params.label: terms_cap_hint

params.name: rates_title
params.default: Roughly what this will cost you
params.label: rates_title

params.name: report_note
params.default: Every run other people made on your keys: what the provider really charged you, and what you charge them.
params.label: report_note

params.name: no_report_title
params.default: Nobody has spent on your keys yet
params.label: no_report_title

params.name: no_report_body
params.default: Lend a key and every run made on it turns up here, per key, per person and per sitting.
params.label: no_report_body

params.name: fund_save
params.default: Save the amount loaded on this key

params.name: add_credit_tip
params.default: Opens this provider's own page, where you add money to the account behind this key. Then press Test - a stopped key starts again.

params.name: mc_note
params.default: Providers add and withdraw models often. Check asks each provider (with your keys) what it offers today: add a new model in one click, retire one that is gone. A model a call finds withdrawn leaves every list by itself.

params.name: mc_lede
params.default: New = offered by the provider, not yet in the portal. Gone = in the portal, not offered any more. Adding and retiring are saved as new versions of the model chips (history kept).

params.name: mc_price_first
params.default: Type its price first - the portal never guesses a price (see the provider's pricing page).

params.name: mc_added
params.default: {model} added - it is in every model picker now.

params.name: mc_gone_seen
params.default: A call was refused: the provider said this model is gone. It is already out of the pickers.

params.name: mc_retire_body
params.default: It leaves every model picker for good (its prices stay, for the history of what was spent). Anything saved with it asks for another model the next time AI is pressed.

params.name: wallet_note
params.default: The portal lends you its keys and takes what each run costs from this one balance. A picture the check throws away is never charged.
params.label: wallet note

params.name: wallet_added_total
params.default: {added} added in all, {refunded} given back for redrawn pictures
params.label: wallet added total

params.name: wallets_note
params.default: Someone pays you by UPI or bank; add the same amount here. Your default key for each provider is lent to them, and every run draws on their one balance.
params.label: wallets note

description_nl: The words of one screen. {placeholders} are filled on the page. A language overrides any of them with chip ui.keys.<lang> (for example ui.keys.hi).
